title: ACP failure: idempotency key reused or still in flight
summary: A retried create request reuses an Idempotency-Key. The server replays, rejects a changed body with 422 or a concurrent duplicate with 409.

steps.label: POST /checkout_sessions (key idem_001)
steps.detail: First attempt; the network times out before the response arrives.

steps.label: Retry, same key, same body
steps.detail: While the first request still runs, the server answers 409 idempotency_in_flight with Retry-After.

failures.condition: Agent retries at once in a loop

steps.label: Replay with Idempotent-Replayed: true
steps.detail: After completion, the same key and body return the original status and body with the replay header.

steps.label: Same key, changed body
steps.detail: A bug sends a different line item with the old key.

steps.label: 422 idempotency_conflict
steps.detail: The spec uses 422; OpenAI documentation says 409 for this code, so handle both.
